human.name: Human
human.description: Versatile and ambitious, humans are adaptable survivors who thrive in almost any environment.

elf.name: Elf
elf.description: Magical, long-lived beings with a deep connection to nature, grace, and ancient wisdom.

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.description: Bold, hardy, and resilient warriors and crafters shaped by deep mountain halls.

halfling.name: Halfling
halfling.description: Small and cheerful folk whose surprising luck and stealth often outshine their modest size.

tiefling.name: Tiefling
tiefling.description: Carrying an infernal heritage, tieflings navigate the world with fiery resolve and charisma.

dragonborn.name: Dragonborn
dragonborn.description: Proud dragon-descendants who honor heritage, honor, and raw elemental breath.

gnome.name: Gnome
gnome.description: Energetic and intensely curious inventors and tricksters driven by enthusiastic passion.

half_orc.name: Half-Orc
half_orc.description: Fierce combatants possessing unstoppable tenacity, physical power, and iron endurance.
